Notes for court users
Parties must report to the usher of the relevant courtroom at least 15 minutes before the listed time.
Matters marked "Remote" will be heard by video link; joining details are sent by the listing office.
Applications to adjourn must be made in writing to the listing office by 4.00 pm on the previous working day.
Mobile telephones must be switched off in all courtrooms. Recording of proceedings without the permission of the judge is a contempt of court.
